claims.text: The Assembly reports that after the newly elected MPs cast their secret ballot, Parliament adjourned until 2.30pm so that the Interim Speaker could have an audience with the King to report the winning candidate to become Prime Minister, and would announce the result when the House resumed.
claims.uncertainty: Records the report to the King. It is not the royal appointment.
